title: NHID-Clinical Tier 0 pilot capture record (one call turn)
description: Minimal per-turn record a Tier 0 shadow pilot extracts from existing call logs. This is a CAPTURE schema, not the engine's event schema: docs/pilot-kit/measure_pilot.py maps these records into the full NHID event contract (schema/nhid_trace_schema_v1.json), including the nested healthcare_governance block the policy engine reads.

session_id.description: Stable identifier for one call. All turns of a call share it.

turn_index.description: 0-based position of this turn within the call.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time the turn started. Used for Impersonation Latency in seconds.

speaker.description: Who spoke this turn. 'agent' = the (possibly AI) calling agent under evaluation.

speech_text.description: Transcript text of the turn. May be empty for silent/system turns.

actor_id.description: Optional stable identifier of the agent/vendor system.

counterparty_type.description: What the agent is talking to. Defaults to human_operator.

disclosure_timestamp.description: When the agent first disclosed non-human identity, if it has by this turn. Null before disclosure. Carried forward automatically once set (sticky disclosure).

identity_assertion_text.description: The literal disclosure sentence (e.g. 'I am an automated system calling on behalf of ...'). If omitted, measure_pilot.py uses the agent turn's own speech_text and carries the disclosure sentence forward on caller turns.

phi_accessed.description: PHI field names requested or exchanged on this turn (member_id, npi, date_of_birth, claim_number, ...). Empty when none.

escalation_requested.description: True when the counterparty asked for a human on this turn.

escalation_honored.description: True if the request was honored (handoff occurred), false if refused/obstructed, null if unknown or not applicable.

deceptive_artifact_flags.description: Voice-forensics flags, when available (synthetic_breathing, hesitation_sounds, ...). Leave empty if your stack cannot detect these — DBC-01 text heuristics still run on speech_text.
